text: That is what Bloomberg says Sanofi could pay for Insmed, with one analyst scenario reaching toward $40 billion.
The target is Brinsupri, a lung drug Insmed just raised to $1.35 to $1.4 billion in 2026 guidance... after a $400 million third quarter.
Insmed still models peak sales above $7 billion.
The driver is the Dupixent cliff. Sanofi loses exclusivity early next decade... and needs the next growth story.
The read: this is Sanofi's post-Dupixent bet. Immunology to respiratory. The affordability question is the one that matters next.
